answer: Every claim climbs the gale of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the willow re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. What survives to the thread is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. The design leans on staked peer review with spot checks, reduced by each unverified claim, auditors are drawn from a rotating pool. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short.
